name: Kevin Sawkins
office: City of San Gabriel, City Treasurer

items.text: Kevin Sawkins is the incumbent City Treasurer of San Gabriel. He previously served on the City Council for 12 years, including as mayor. He is an attorney who has run his own law practice since 1996, handling personal injury, civil litigation, and criminal defense cases.
